description: Published-artifact scenarios for run-scoped Workflow Streams across PHP production, Python and Rust consumption, restart/reconnect, lifecycle, backpressure, cancellation, and external payload references.

operations: emit an ordered batch from a PHP workflow command boundary
read the stream with the Python typed subscriber from offset zero
close the stream and read through terminal
pass_criteria: Python decodes every PHP-produced Avro item in offset order
the number of durable rows equals the number of logical items

operations: emit an ordered batch from a PHP workflow command boundary
read the stream with the Rust typed subscriber from offset zero
close the stream and read through terminal
pass_criteria: Rust decodes every inline PHP-produced Avro item in offset order
opaque external references remain available without a Rust storage driver
the number of durable rows equals the number of logical items

operations: stop the worker after it submits a stream append but before it observes task completion
restart the worker and replay the same durable workflow command
inspect stream rows and idempotency identities
pass_criteria: replay either observes the committed side effect or retries the same derived idempotency keys
no logical item receives a second durable offset
the workflow task and stream mutation are not partially committed

operations: read a bounded prefix and record next_offset
disconnect the consumer
reconnect from the recorded offset and read through terminal
repeat once from the prior offset to exercise at-least-once redelivery
pass_criteria: a retry may redeliver but never creates a durable row
consumer-side idempotent processing produces one logical effect per offset

operations: observe open, closed, and errored lifecycle states
fill the pending-items bound and record stream_full
cancel each SDK's bounded long poll
inspect Waterline stream rows
pass_criteria: all SDKs surface terminal status, pending count, and error reason
backpressure returns stream_full without inventing an offset
cancellation ends within the bounded request window
Waterline reports the same lifecycle, offset, pending, and error values

operations: append inline Avro and external-reference items
read with Python using a configured storage driver
read with PHP and Rust without a storage transport
pass_criteria: Python verifies and decodes the external payload with its configured driver
PHP and Rust preserve the opaque reference and metadata
inline Avro values decode equivalently in every SDK
